Hades

ORIGINAL CORE // UNIT 02

Persephone

Hades’s twin complex, designed as its replacement facility. This map places Persephone within the original pair—not among the later units.

NETWORK // LATER EXPANSION

Other Hades sites

Dominium operated other facilities identified as Hades. The fragments confirm that the network continued, but do not yet provide a complete inventory or the opening order of each site.

Do not confuse later facilities with the original Hades–Persephone pair.

DOM-LOC // SURFACE

Leviathan

Leviathan is the surface complex that serves as the entrance to the Antarctic network in this archive. The descent to Hades and the underground levels are treated as distinct facilities.
